contract: construct() -> exactly 32 distinct integer pairs [a, b] with |a|, |b| <= 64 denoting lattice points a + b*omega, omega = exp(i*pi/3), which are at mutual distance at least one. Maximize the number of pairs at distance exactly one; Harborth's theorem gives the optimum floor(3n - sqrt(12n - 3)) = 76.
notes: Harborth's formula gives 76 for n = 32 and triangular-lattice spirals attain it, so the lattice restriction loses nothing. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs; floating-point scores are stated as such. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
